senses.gloss: m. (= עִידָּן, עִירָּנָא; אוד, עוד) time.—הָאִידְּנָא this time, now, to-day.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 1:6">Targ. Y. Deut. I, 6</cite> (usu. with <cite ref="P00000"><he>ע</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Yoma 19b:16">Yoma 19ᵇ</cite> <he>הא׳ יומא וכ׳</he> to-day is the Day of Atone.
<cite ref="Berakhot 4a:7">Ber. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>כי הא׳</he> at this very time (hour).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 71b:2">Kidd. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>והא׳ דאיכא רמאי</he> but now-a-days when there are deceivers; a. fr.
